claims: Hulu has renewed the Sterling K. Brown-led drama Paradise for a third and final season.
Filming for Paradise season 3 is expected to begin in April 2026.
Paradise season 3 has a potential early 2027 release.
Dan Fogelman is the creator of Paradise.
Dan Fogelman designed Paradise with a strict three-season arc.
Paradise season 3 will conclude the story.
Hulu officially renewed Paradise season 3 on March 17, 2026 ahead of the season 2 finale according to Deadline.
Entertainment Weekly suggests a 2027 release for Paradise season 3.
Filming for Paradise season 3 is expected to run from roughly April 2026 through August 2026 according to details mentioned by Sterling K. Brown to People.com.
Dan Fogelman indicated that Paradise was designed to be a three-season plan similar to This Is Us.
